narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think week two is five z, because the distance is multiplied by z each week.
<bookmark mark='s1'/>The daily distance grows by adding z, not by multiplying.
<bookmark mark='s2'/>Week two has five plus z each day.
<bookmark mark='s4'/>The new distance is six each day, but five z gives five.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows his idea; it is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='s2'/>The weeks are thirty five, forty two and forty nine, which add to one hundred and twenty six.
<bookmark mark='s3'/>The formula one hundred and five plus twenty one z also gives one hundred and twenty six.
